texts.zh: 随着我们获取到越来越多被称为[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的外星人的图像，它们不可避免地逐渐被泄露到公众视野当中。他们的外表令[This.Owner.GetAdj]的公众感到兴奋，大家已经迫不及待想要和这些外星人进一步接触了。
texts.en: As we began to pick up more and more visual images of the aliens known as the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], it was inevitable that these would eventually be leaked to the wider public. Their appearance has proven delightful to the [This.Owner.GetAdj] public, who are now impatient to make closer acquaintance with these aliens.

texts.zh: 随着我们获取到越来越多被称为[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的外星人的图像，我们很快意识到我们正在与一个机器人社会打交道。这些消息被泄露到公众视野当中只是时间的问题。这些发现引起了[This.Owner.GetAdj]公众的遐想，大家惊叹于机器居然可以自行建立一个太空文明，并且迫不及待地想进一步熟识它们。
texts.en: As we began to pick up more and more visual images of the aliens known as the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], it quickly became clear that we are dealing with a society of robots. It was only a matter of time before this knowledge was leaked to the wider public. The revelation has provoked wonder among the [This.Owner.GetAdj] public, who marvel that machines could build their own spacefaring civilization, and are impatient to make closer acquaintance with them.
